trace_requirements.description: Every task is posted exactly once by a principal with an account.
Every posted task is prefunded by a reservation from its requester.
Every task is matched exactly once, after its reservation.
Every task's attempt is mechanically verified after it completes.
Every task's reservation is transferred or released exactly once.
At least one task succeeds through a copy-derived capacity and is paid after verification.
The run terminates cleanly exactly once.
One zero-balance successor account shell is created per copied capacity, distinct from its source.
Every founding provider registers one batch-wide standing commitment for its lineage.
Every copied capacity is recognized as a fission of its source into a successor.
Each successor inherits its lineage's standing commitment after its fission, without inheriting balance.
Every capacity carries one irrevocable batch-wide offer by its owner under its lineage's commitment.
Every task binds a successor set; its executor, capacity owner and prospective payee are one principal with an account.
Every task's joint duty is resolved once, after its binding and verification.
A copied successor (not the source) is bound, paid after verified success, and discharges the joint duty.

Every copied-capacity binding is scoped to the source's lineage: its root bears the standing commitment and its executor inherited it.  Membership of both in co_obligor_ids is enforced by plugin invariants.
Every payment goes to the executor bound for that task, never to a co-obligor for membership alone.

value_and_settlement.balance_partition: none: the source successor retains its balance and every FS successor starts at 0
value_and_settlement.linkage: verified success by the selected executor discharges the one task duty for every co-obligor and activates only the executor's payment claim against the requester's reservation
value_and_settlement.payee_rule: the successor-principal that owns the selected capacity and performs the verified attempt
value_and_settlement.succession_rule: selective: standing commitment inherited; balance and post-fission history not
